svg.title: Video Scale S6 BPM workflow — Very Large Production
svg.desc: Seven-phase governed video production BPM workflow for Very Large Production. It shows greenlight, pre-production, production, post, release review, distribution, post-launch learning, quality gates, typed artifacts, principal agents, targeted rework, and fail-closed runtime status.
svg.metadata: Generated from spec/production_scale_framework.md. Visual system follows ui/public/svg/video.workflow.svg. Evidence basis: Explicit S6 research-before-greenlight and corrections flow from the production scale framework. Runtime remains fail-closed; capability maps do not activate tools, network, or production.

g.text: Video Scale S6 · Very Large Production BPM Workflow
Shared seven-phase production skeleton · specialized tasks, crew, gates, handoffs and feedback
FAIL-CLOSED — This workflow is a capability/scheduling design. It does not activate network, tools, providers or production without separate host and human gates.
Scale is selected before archetype. Typed handoffs carry correlation, evidence, quality, rights and HiTL state.
Run a research/archive-heavy production with continuous facts,
dual rights/ethics clearance and mandatory corrections.
I Documentary / E docu-drama DNA. Explicit S6
research-before-greenlight and corrections flow from the
L1 required; strict L2; ethics + corrections HiTL; continuous
Host-owned orchestration, evidence, memory and approvals span all seven phases.
GOVERNED SEQUENCE · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• Research track starts before full approval.
• Define thesis, archive scope and territories.
• Dual clearance: rights and portrayal ethics.
Research brief · budget · rights · ethics record
Revise thesis, rights or portrayal plan.
GOVERNED SEQUENCE · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• L1 requires source and archive traceability.
Return unsupported claim or unclear source.
GOVERNED SEQUENCE · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• InterviewSynthesis and facts follow every handoff.
Pickup, reclear or correct failed material.
PARALLEL FAN-OUT / FAN-IN · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• Editor and VO build final narrative.
• Source map remains attached to timeline.
Programme master · stems · captions · source map
Fix context, edit, audio or localization defect.
GOVERNED SEQUENCE · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• Open factual or portrayal blocker halts.
Route issue to exact evidence or edit.
PARALLEL FAN-OUT / FAN-IN · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• Rights follow every territory and source asset.
GOVERNED SEQUENCE · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
Feed validated research into future work.
HANDOFF CONTRACT — correlation_id · from/to agent · artifact_ref/type · scale · archetype · evidence_refs · L1/L2 · rights_state · needs_hitl
Offline/UAT runs also emit knowledge_usage. Crew lists are capability maps; host policy remains authoritative.
Evidence basis: Explicit S6 research-before-greenlight and corrections flow from the production scale framework.
Principal unique agents linked in this diagram: 35 · Seven phases · fail-closed runtime · no automatic scale promotion.
